Exhibit P 'Other Purchased Services' is mapped to professional/contract services throughout. The state object group also covers insurance, communications, travel and tuition paid to other districts, so the mapping is a judgment call (e.g. SPED 105,436.78 detail[46], Speech SPED 121,223.75 detail[60]).
Operation of plant 'Supplies' usually includes energy (electricity, natural gas), so this could partly be utilities (power, gas, phone). The page does not break it down.
